spec.title: How an agent reads this manual
spec.p: This manual is published for machines as much as for people. An agent can fetch any page as plain text, ask where a rule lives, and load the whole corpus in one file sized to its budget.

tr.td: the index: one line per page, the page's first paragraph
one page as plain Markdown, block numbers included
the same page in its source form, with every rule address and example intact
to quote a rule or run an example
the corpus in three sizes, stable text first
only when a task spans many pages
every page with its language, audiences, status and anchors
the resolver: an address in, the page and block out
when a message or a page cites an address
the same files for another language
when the user reads that language

offline.title: Without a network
offline.p: The same pages live in the machine store once `vibe cache add org.vibevm.core/vibevm-docs` has run. `vibe explain "spec://org.vibevm.core/vibevm-docs/<page>#<anchor>"` prints a page or a block; `vibe doc manifest --llms small` prints the index from the store. Nothing on this path contacts the network, which is why proprietary documentation is read this way.

citing.title: Citing a place
citing.p: Every block on a page carries a number, `p12` and so on, assigned when the page is built and the same in the web page, the Markdown and the XML. A citation is the page address plus that number: `spec://org.vibevm.core/vibevm-docs/model/boot-lane#p7`. Headings keep their named anchors as well, and a named anchor never changes once published; a block number names the current text and may shift after an edit, like a line number.

Rules on a page are quoted from the specification by address and shown in the specification's own language. Prefer the address of the specification over the address of the manual when you tell a user what a rule says; prefer the manual's page when you explain why.

procedure.title: The procedure the skill teaches
procedure.p: 1. On an error, read the address the message names, then the page the diagnostics page maps it to. 2. On a question, answer from one page: the first paragraph is the plain answer, the rule blocks carry the exact wording. 3. On a task, take the page's request block as your task, substitute the user's names and paths, run it, then run the asserts; the task is done when every assert exits zero. 4. When choosing among documentations of one package, prefer the one marked official and name the publisher of a community one. 5. Never load the full corpus when one page answers.

edge-cases.title: Edge cases and rules
edge-cases.p: Text written for agents is never part of a project's boot lane; this manual is fetched when needed, not read at every session start.
A page that exists in the source language but not in the language you asked for is served in the source language under the address you asked for, with a note; do not treat it as missing.
